finding.headline: "The Cabin-Fever Prisoner"
finding.problem: "The baby cries, the washing machine hums, the phone stays quiet. I went three days without speaking to another grown-up. I feel like I've vanished."
finding.person: Mum who, like the MAM Baby stat, has gone days without adult conversation; stares at the same four walls, feels trapped and invisible.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "The Daily Adult: 10-Minute Rituals to End the Silence."". Verdict: PASSES.
